notes: 0.3.59：修复 apply.ps1 编码退化导致的 B 机拉取失败。此前编辑工具把 apply.ps1 从带 BOM 的 UTF-16/UTF-8 改成无 BOM UTF-8，Windows PowerShell 5.1 按 GBK 解析致中文注释乱码、脚本解析阶段即 ParserError。本版恢复 apply.ps1 的 UTF8-BOM，隔离环境实测 5 工作区还原、会话首帧 cwd 修正 44、projcache 修正 44 全部通过。0.3.58 及以前的功能（仓库改名、projcache 目录反推、dsh-purge 1.4.0 对齐）全部保留。产物 releases\dsh-config-sync-plugin-0.3.59.tgz。
notesEn: 0.3.59: fix apply.ps1 encoding regression that broke pull on the B machine. Earlier edits stripped the BOM from apply.ps1 (UTF-16/UTF-8 with BOM -> UTF-8 without BOM); Windows PowerShell 5.1 then decoded it as GBK, garbling Chinese comments and raising ParserError at parse time. This build restores the UTF8-BOM on apply.ps1. Isolated replay verified: 5 workspaces restored, 44 session-header cwd fixes, 44 projcache fixes, all passing. All 0.3.58-and-earlier features retained (repo rename, projcache folder inference, dsh-purge 1.4.0 alignment). Artifact releases\dsh-config-sync-plugin-0.3.59.tgz.
